svg.aria-label: Start C4 + E4, end D4 + F4. The lower voice moves from C4 to D4, up 2 semitones. The upper voice moves from E4 to F4, up 1 semitone. Similar motion, not strict parallel in this course. The pair changes from a major third (4 semitones) to a minor third (3 semitones).
svg.title: Change 5: both rise, a major third becomes a minor third

g.text: How to read this graphic: Two arrows go the same way but are not the same size: the
lower voice steps over a black key (up 2) and the upper takes one step (up 1). That
difference is why the pair changes size. The end keys carry the minor third colour.
